output.situation: Emergency & Crisis Authority has received information that emergency calls from Downtown are failing, which may indicate an issue with the telecom network.

applicable_rules.quote: Mandate M-A3-INFORMATION — agent A3 (Emergency & crisis authority, modelled on NCEMA (incl. its Civil Defence Authority)). Obtain information from the competent and concerned authorities. Permitted action types: request_information.
applicable_rules.why: To gather necessary information about the telecom network failure.

applicable_rules.quote: Mandate M-A3-CD-COORDINATION — agent A3 (Emergency & crisis authority, modelled on NCEMA (incl. its Civil Defence Authority)). Coordinate the services needed to address potential risks (civil defence). Permitted action types: activate_crisis_coordination.
applicable_rules.why: To coordinate with other authorities and civil defense services in addressing the telecom network issue.

output.why: Given the situation, it is important to first obtain information from the Telecom Regulator about the failure of emergency calls. This will help determine if the issue lies within their domain or requires further investigation.

messages.content: Request information on the failure of emergency calls in Downtown, as it may indicate a network issue.
